# imagefast

> Image dimensions, thumbnails and RAW previews in the browser, on a worker pool. Zero dependencies, 11 KB gzipped, with opt-in decoders for camera RAW, HEIC, TIFF and PSD. ESM only; runs in browsers (Chrome and Edge 94+, Firefox 114+, Safari 17+), not in Node.

Install with `npm install imagefast`.

```ts
import { createImageFast } from 'imagefast';
import { raw } from 'imagefast/raw'; // optional decoders: also 'imagefast/heic', 'imagefast/tiff', 'imagefast/psd'

const fast = createImageFast({ plugins: [raw] }); // one instance per app, created in browser-only code

const { width, height, format } = await fast.dimensions(file); // header only, no decode
const { blob } = await fast.thumbnail(file, { width: 1024, type: 'image/webp' }); // done in a worker
const { bitmap } = await fast.bitmap(file, { width: 800, height: 600, fit: 'cover' }); // close() it after drawing
```

- Create one instance and reuse it. With server rendering, create it after mount: it throws `ImageFastError('unsupported')` without `OffscreenCanvas`, `createImageBitmap` or `Worker`.
- Use `dimensions()` to measure an image; do not decode one just to read its size.
- RAW, HEIC, TIFF and PSD need their plugin in `plugins`. Without it the call rejects with code `no-decoder`.
- Calls reject with an `ImageFastError`: branch on `error.code` (`no-decoder`, `decode-failed`, `aborted`, `terminated`, `worker-crashed`).
- Every call takes `{ signal }`; `AbortSignal.timeout(ms)` makes a timeout.
- Thumbnails are oriented, never upscaled and carry no EXIF.
